tasks.label: ТВОЯ РОЛЬ
tasks.q: Королівський табір біля Тризуба. Ти не бачив сварки на березі, але тепер лорд Нед доручає тобі з'ясувати, що там сталося: розпитати людей, оглянути місце і зробити висновки до суду перед королем.
tasks.q_pl: Królewski obóz przy Tridencie. Nie widziałeś kłótni nad rzeką, ale teraz lord Ned zleca ci wyjaśnić, co się stało: wypytać ludzi, obejrzeć miejsce i wyciągnąć wnioski przed sądem u króla.
tasks.q_en: The royal camp by the Trident. You didn't see the quarrel on the riverbank, but now Lord Ned asks you to find out what happened: question people, look at the scene and draw conclusions before the hearing with the king.

tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Modal + have + past participle gives a deduction about the past. Must have = I'm almost sure it happened: The children must have been playing here. Might / could have = it's possible: Nymeria might have run into the woods. Can't / couldn't have = I'm sure it didn't happen: The wolf can't have bitten him for no reason. Don't say must have to or must has.
tasks.q_pl: Modal + have + past participle gives a deduction about the past. Must have = I'm almost sure it happened: The children must have been playing here. Might / could have = it's possible: Nymeria might have run into the woods. Can't / couldn't have = I'm sure it didn't happen: The wolf can't have bitten him for no reason. Don't say must have to or must has.

Might / could have = it's possible: Nymeria might have run into the woods. Can't / couldn't have = I'm sure it didn't happen: The wolf can't have bitten him for no reason. Don't say must have to or must has.
